observations.why: Ratification language performs the settling of the async job contract; the speaker records a completed decision, not an argued-for position.

Operational guarantee stated as a settled rule of the ratified contract — 'no' functions as an absolute, not a hedged aspiration; the boundary with claim holds because the ratification is already performed in src-1 and this extends it.
The speaker explicitly labels the statement a decision and specifies the operational pattern the agent will follow — performed settling, not an argued-for claim.
